newsitem.title: USA: Weekend warmth for Plains, watching next week - WSC.
newsitem.headline: Weekend warmth for Plains, watching next week - WSC.

text.p: The hard red winter wheat crop growing areas in the U.S. Central Plains will see much warmer temperatures this weekend, but cold is seen returning to the region next week, a U.S. meteorologist said Friday.

"We will have to keep our eye on next week," said Mike Palmerino, meteorologist with Weather Services Corp. in Lexington, Mass. "It looks like it will continue to cool off in the HRW (hard red winter wheat) belt."
After Central Plains temperatures climb into the 70s and 80s (degrees Fahrenheit) this weekend, cooler weather will move into the Plains states beginning Sunday, Palmerino said.
